description: Random number in [min, max] with N decimals. Seeded (stable) — press Re-roll for a new draw.
instructions:
Emits a DETERMINISTIC pseudo-random number in [min, max], rounded to `decimals` places, on `val-result`. The draw is keyed on `seed` so the preview is stable and matches commit — press Re-roll to bump the seed for a fresh number. min/max are wireable (`valin-min` / `valin-max`).

TIP: use it to vary layouts reproducibly — feed val-result into Optimise Rectangle's tilt/count, or a Split ratio.
